ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_for_access IS
 ucnt NUMBER := 0;
 dcnt NUMBER := 0;
 v_flg VARCHAR2(1) := 'N';
 lv_user_id VARCHAR2(10);
 v_sysdate DATE;
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.uaccess := '';

 IF v_flg = 'N' THEN 
 
 IF SUBSTR(lt_user_session.get_userid, 1, 4) = 'OPS$' THEN
 lv_user_id := SUBSTR(lt_user_session.get_userid, 5);
 ELSE
 lv_user_id := lt_user_session.get_userid;
 END IF; 
 
 -- IM 124
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 v_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 else
 v_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 --
 
 
 SELECT count(*) INTO ucnt
 FROM valid_lab_user_access
 WHERE user_id = lv_user_id
 AND access_class = 'UNOTE'
 AND v_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, v_sysdate+1); -- IM 124
 
 IF ucnt = 0 THEN
 globalvar.g_access := 'N'; -- Used to disable NOTE field.
 END IF; 
 
 SELECT count(*) INTO dcnt
 FROM valid_lab_user_access
 WHERE user_id = lv_user_id
 AND access_class = 'DNOTE'
 AND v_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, v_sysdate+1); -- IM 124
 
 IF ucnt > 0 AND dcnt > 0 THEN
 :ctrl_block.warn := NULL;
 v_flg := 'Y';
 --------
 if get_item_property( 'note_books.note',ENABLED)='FALSE' then 
 item_change('note_books.note','E');
 end if; 
 -------
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_save',enabled,property_true);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_delete',enabled,property_true); 
 END IF;
 
 IF ucnt = 0 AND dcnt = 0 THEN 
 v_flg := 'Y';
 item_change('note_books.note','D');
 :ctrl_block.warn:='Your access level is for viewing notes only. Addition/Deletion is denied!!!! ';
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_save',enabled,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_delete',enabled,property_false);
 set_item_property('note_books.note',insert_allowed,property_false); --Added MLT 63
 set_item_property('note_books.note',update_allowed,property_false);
 END IF;
 
 IF ucnt > 0 AND dcnt = 0 THEN 
 v_flg := 'Y';
 --------
 IF get_item_property( 'note_books.note',ENABLED)='FALSE' THEN 
 item_change('note_books.note','E');
 END IF;
 -------
 
 :ctrl_block.warn:='Your access level is for viewing and adding notes. Deletion of notes is denied!!!! ';
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_save',enabled,property_true);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_delete',enabled,property_false);
 END IF;
 
 
 IF ucnt = 0 AND dcnt > 0 THEN 
 v_flg := 'Y';
 item_change('note_books.note','D');
 :ctrl_block.warn:='Your access level is for viewing and deleting notes. Adding notes is denied!!!! ';
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_delete',enabled,property_true);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_save',enabled,property_false);
 set_item_property('note_books.note',insert_allowed,property_false); -- Added MLT 63
 set_item_property('note_books.note',update_allowed,property_false);
 END IF;
 END IF; 


END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DYNAMIC_CURSOR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dynamic_cursor ( PC$TblName IN Varchar2, PC$Clause IN Varchar2 )
IS
 cursor_number EXEC_SQL.CursType; 
 -- Variables for the data to be returned into 
 LN$NoteID Number; 
 --LC$Name Varchar2(30); 
 -- Control variables 
 LN$count Number; 
 LC$sql_order Varchar2(256);
 nRows PLS_INTEGER := 0; -- Used for counting the number of rows returned.
BEGIN
 
 -- Open the cursor -- 
 cursor_number := Exec_SQL.Open_cursor; 
 
 -- build the complete SQL order -- 
 LC$sql_order := 'SELECT note_id FROM ' || PC$TblName || ' ' || PC$clause ;
 
 -- Parse the SQL order --
 EXEC_SQL.PARSE(cursor_number, LC$sql_order); 
 
 -- Define the columns for the data to be returned --
 EXEC_SQL.DEFINE_COLUMN(cursor_number,1,LN$NoteID); 
 --EXEC_SQL.DEFINE_COLUMN(cursor_number,2,LC$Name,30); 
 
 -- Execute the Cursor --
 LN$count := EXEC_SQL.EXECUTE(cursor_number); 
 
 -- Loop and fetch each row from the result set --
 While EXEC_SQL.FETCH_ROWS(cursor_number) > 0 Loop 
 nRows := nRows + 1;
 EXEC_SQL.COLUMN_VALUE(cursor_number,1,LN$NoteID); 
 --EXEC_SQL.COLUMN_VALUE(cursor_number,2,LC$Name); 
 
 -- message the result -- 
 --message('Fetched: '||LC$Name||' Empno='||to_char(LN$Empno));
 
 End Loop ;
 
 -- Close the cursors 
 EXEC_SQL.CLOSE_CURSOR(cursor_number); 
 
 --MESSAGE('@#Rows found ' || nRows);pause;
 --MESSAGE('@#Note ID ' || LN$NoteID);pause;
 
 IF nRows > 1 THEN
 MESSAGE('@$Multiple Records found with the same Note ID');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 :ctrl_block.note_id := LN$NoteID;
 
EXCEPTION 
 When EXEC_SQL.INVALID_CONNECTION Then
 message('Unexpected Invalid Connection error from EXEC_SQL'); 

 When EXEC_SQL.PACKAGE_ERROR Then
 message('Unexpected error from EXEC_SQL: '||to_char(EXEC_SQL.LAST_ERROR_CODE)|| EXEC_SQL.LAST_ERROR_MESG); 

 If EXEC_SQL.IS_OPEN(cursor_number) Then
 EXEC_SQL.CLOSE_CURSOR(cursor_number); 
 message('Exception - Cleaned up Cursor'); 
 End if; 

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ITEM_CHANGE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE item_change (p_item_name in varchar2,p_mode in varchar2) IS
 it_id item ;
BEGIN
 it_id := find_item(p_item_name) ;
 IF Id_Null(it_id) THEN 
 Message('No such item: '||p_item_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 else
 if p_mode = 'E' then
 IF get_item_property(it_id, ENABLED) = 'FALSE' THEN
 set_item_property(it_id,ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE) ;
 set_item_property(it_id,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE) ;
 if get_item_property(it_id,ITEM_TYPE) != 'BUTTON' then
 set_item_property(it_id,UPDATEABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE) ;
 end if ;
 END IF;
 elsif p_mode = 'D' then
 set_item_property(it_id,ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE) ;
 end if ;
 end if ;
END;
